question.text: 'Vasudha Accredited Opportunities AIF' is structured such that each investor commits a minimum capital contribution of INR 70 crore and has provided a waiver from PPM template and annual audit. Per the chapter, this exemption threshold (in INR or equivalent USD) is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 13.5.2, the PPM template and annual audit requirements are not applicable to AIFs/Schemes in which each investor commits a minimum capital contribution of INR 70 crore (USD 10 million or equivalent in case of non-INR capital commitment) AND provides a waiver from the PPM template and annual audit requirements. **The Trap:** INR 25/50 crore are lower thresholds used elsewhere (e.g., minimum AIF investor commitment is INR 1 crore, sponsor continuing interest has different thresholds). INR 100 crore is the Angel Fund threshold for mandatory audit from FY25-26. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A tests investor-side thresholds; XIX-C tests the PPM waiver mechanism which is manager-side relevant. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Even if all LPs qualify for waiver, check written waivers are obtained individually — the waiver is investor-specific. Missing even one waiver triggers full PPM audit obligation.
